rationale: Explicit user authorization covers one read-only, sanitized interactive/status-only AGY quota query. The pre-query quota band is truthfully unknown and is permitted solely to discover a safe band. Send no work prompt and retain or report no account email, session identifier, raw TUI/transcript, or path. The durable result is only a safe quota-band classification or sanitized failure classification. This decision does not authorize an AGY work dispatch, an R3 execution decision, or an R3 scheduling snapshot.
